messages:
eli: Quick heads-up: after changing our package exports we got reports of vite/dev server + deno samples failing. Error: ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED and missing declaration files. Anyone seen similar?

maya: yep, saw 3 customer tickets. repro usually pnpm monorepo + symlink + vite or a deno import map fetch.

sam: our latest package.json exports only had import/require and we left types out. That breaks TS resolvers and some bundlers.

rafa: simple fix: add types under exports and export ./package.json. Example: "./package.json": "./package.json", "./types": "./types/index.d.ts" under exports. Also add default condition.

eli: for immediate relief I'm asking support to advise pin to 2.0.x and apply `patch-package` to add the types entry.

maya: longer term: update build to copy a root types file (dist/index.d.ts), add an exports lint that ensures types + package.json are exported, and add a tiny vite + deno sample to CI that symlinks the sdk.

ci-bot: CI task created: add symlink-vite + deno sample to smoke tests.

sam: I'll open a patch release PR and include the exports/types tweak + tests.

rafa: thanks. Also document the recommended import patterns (no deep imports) so consumers don't rely on dist paths.

eli: perfect. I'll coordinate support comms once patch cuts.
